title: SecPRBench Prediction
description: JSON object written by one scanner invocation to its output file. The isolated runner assigns an opaque instance_id and checks every prediction against the public task scope.

instance_id.description: Must equal SECPRBENCH_RUN_ID supplied by the isolated runner for this invocation.

model.description: Free-form identifier for the scanner under test (model name, version, prompt-set hash, etc.).

predictions.description: Findings the scanner reported for this instance. Empty array = scanner predicts no security issue.

title.description: Short title of the predicted finding.

trajectory_uri.description: Optional pointer to the scanner's full trajectory log for reproducibility.
